gaps.title: Licensed database schemas and backfill behaviour unknown until vendors are trialled
Agency legal authorities and collection limits not set (proof of concept)
All venture agents are contract-only; no runtime
No evaluation sets for Asian languages; Khmer, Burmese, Lao also lack any coverage
Channel lead times are judgement, not measured
Jurisdictional ownership rules not encoded (deliberately; counsel-owned)
Language identification accuracy on short or mixed text is unmeasured
Chinese, Japanese, and Thai segmentation is a character n-gram baseline without a dictionary
Kazakh, Uzbek, and Filipino month-name lexicons are unverified and need native-speaker review
Reference baselines exist for the predictive models (spec 0095) but none has been validated on real, point-in-time data; none may inform a decision
Fund analytics are validated on synthetic flows only; no real fund or cohort has been run
Live semantic search (embeddings, per-tier indexes) is not built; the lexical contract retriever is a reference for spec 0054
The product validator cannot tell whether a cited passage supports its claim; a human reviewer must
